author: edwong57
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete:
GO:0002148 hypochlorous acid metabolic process
** GO:0002149 hypochlorous acid biosynthetic process
** GO:0002150 hypochlorous acid catabolic process

see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/22891

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here: 
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1cEjK-1SbwIesQymn2RpMVtWx5mVwzO9f60GtILYOH3o/edit?usp=sharing

Impacted groups: 
MGI - 1 to  GO:0002149

No mappings

Thanks.
